data.description:
## Context
The current-main macOS census attributes 250.81 worker-phase seconds to external analyzer/grounding tests, with individual phases up to 15.62s. Multiple modules launch real OpenGrep, ast-grep, gitleaks, and metric scans. Reusing immutable scan results or retaining one real boundary per behavior could reduce repeated tool startup and traversal, but the evidence is not yet sufficient to remove or mock any real boundary.

Tracker guard: shockproof-twill-porpoise proves tool presence/absence and explicit coverage accounting are contractual. crushable-choosable-llama retains real scanner/process integration. OSS practice is mixed: pip and pytest reuse expensive session fixtures, while Semgrep retains real CLI snapshot E2E tests marked kinda_slow. No automatic OSS-consensus approval exists yet.

## Plan
- Inventory every >=1s analyzer node, the exact binary invocation, fixture tree, detector/backend, and unique failure mode.
- Build a fault-seeded equivalence matrix for discovery, rule loading, timeout, invalid output, tool absent, tool present, SARIF/evidence normalization, and consumer fail-open/fail-closed behavior.
- Measure candidates that share immutable fixture trees or scan results while retaining at least one real invocation for each external boundary and environment state.
- Compare matched before/after timings and retained failure-mode detection with maintained OSS examples.
- Recommend implement/keep only after every removed invocation has equivalent behavioral and contractual detection.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every affected real-tool invocation maps to a unique failure mode and faster overlapping oracle, if any.
- [ ] Tool present, tool absent, timeout, invalid output, rule discovery, and evidence-accounting contracts remain explicit.
- [ ] Exact-defect mutations prove the proposed retained set detects every reachable failure class.
- [ ] macOS wall and aggregate runner savings are measured on matched runs.
- [ ] Ticket history and at least three maintained OSS projects are cited.
- [ ] No scanner invocation is removed or mocked until equivalence is proven.
data.title: Prove grounding scan reuse preserves real analyzer boundary coverage
